blocks.content:
• Article 268–272 → Distribution of taxes
• Article 275 → Grants-in-aid
• Article 280 → Finance Commission
• Article 281 → Report to President

items: Article 280 (Finance Commission) is a high-yield topic frequently tested in polity sections.
Do not confuse Article 275 (Grants-in-aid) with general revenue sharing under Articles 268–272.
Article 281 explicitly outlines the duty to lay the Finance Commission's report before the President.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Articles 268 to 272 specify the constitutional provisions governing the distribution of taxes.
Article 275 makes provisions for Grants-in-aid to states in need of assistance.
Article 280 mandates the establishment of the Finance Commission.
Article 281 concerns the submission of the Finance Commission's recommendations and report to the President.
